title: Saadani: Where the Bush Meets the Beach
excerpt: Saadani is the only park in Tanzania where the bush meets the Indian Ocean. A safari and a beach in one place.
body:
Saadani National Park lies on the coast between Dar es Salaam and Tanga. It is the place in Tanzania where savannah and sea meet.

## What makes Saadani special

- Beaches inside the park.
- Boat trips on the Wami River, with hippos, crocodiles and birds.
- Game drives with giraffes, buffaloes, elephants and antelope.
- Green turtles that nest on some beaches.

## Expectations

Wildlife densities are lower than in the Serengeti. Saadani is about the combination, the quiet and the setting.

## When

Dry season is best. The park is warm and humid all year.

## Getting there

By road from Dar es Salaam (several hours) or by light aircraft.

## Combine

With [Pangani and Ushongo](/blog/tanzania-coast-beyond-zanzibar/), the [Usambara Mountains](/blog/usambara-mountains-lushoto/) or Zanzibar.

Read our [Saadani page](/national-parks/saadani-national-park/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
